notes.title: Big UPDATE 1.0.29
notes.notes: [p]After reviews and streams, it was decided to significantly improve the interface and provide more detailed instructions at the start of the game.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45658287/66174f7baae91d92c92ca097303a67d0cc0eac07.jpg"][/img][/p][p]A signpost has also been added — if you approach it, it will display a tutorial.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45658287/29b0c059191000023bf42812b335c079faaff0e4.jpg"][/img][/p][p]Zombie groan sounds have been added when they collide with any traps.[/p][p][/p][p]Background sounds have been lowered so they don't interfere with enjoying the soundtrack.[/p][p][/p][p]The closed door icon is now marked with a red cross.[/p][p][/p][p]The time-based level balance has been adjusted.[/p][p][/p][p]Levels 13 and 14 have been slightly modified.[/p][p][/p][p]The "Recommended" difficulty level has been renamed to "Expert", as it turned out to be too hard to complete on a first playthrough.[/p][p][/p][p]The level stats are now easier to see next to the level entrance.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45658287/6d60be870f6b75ea9576ea4155b776dd62df5054.jpg"][/img][/p][p]Other minor bug fixes.[/p][p][/p][p]Thank you for your feedback ❤️❤️❤️[/p]

notes.title: 🔔 Posted something about NEKRO3? I’ll feature you in the official Steam news!
notes.notes:
[p]Hi there![/p][p]If you’ve made (or plan to make) a review, post, video, stream, reaction — or even just wrote a few words about the NEKRO3 demo — I’d love to highlight your work and thank you for it.[/p][p]💀 I’m making this game alone, and every bit of feedback right now is like a light in the dark.
It doesn’t matter how many followers you have — I value every sincere mention, even if it’s just a few lines on a wall.[/p][p]If you talked about the game, just let me know — and I’ll add your content to the [b]official news section[/b] on Steam. It’s my way of saying thank you.[/p][hr][/hr][h3]How to be featured:[/h3][p]📩 Just send me a link to your video or post:
– in a comment under this announcement
– or by email (if that’s more convenient)[/p][p][/p][p]🎥 What counts:
– YouTube / VK / Twitch videos
– TikTok / Shorts / Reels
– blog posts, forum discussions, impressions
– even a short message about how the game made you feel[/p][hr][/hr][p]This isn’t a contest or a promo campaign.
Just a small tradition: the game is about death — but we’re all very much alive.[/p][p]Thanks for being here.
— [b]\[CHVDR][/b][/p][p][/p][p]🖤 These first reactions feel like light in the dark.[/p][p]They reminded me why I started all of this.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45658287/3711382e20503eafe61e7bfab8dc01bce2a5193a.jpg"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45658287/2a08d06ca3fa53dce6d1556a20a9e559bb00f35b.jpg"][/img][/p]

notes.title: 🕯️ NEKRO3 DEMO IS NOW AVAILABLE!
notes.notes:
[p]The demo version of [i]NEKRO3[/i] is now live — an atmospheric 2D horror where you play as a dying protagonist. Unarmed, but not hopeless.[/p][p]The demo includes [b]5 levels[/b], deadly traps, zombies, and your first encounter with something that hunts even your glowing corpse.[/p][p][b]Important:[/b] the demo already features key mechanics:
— luring zombies into traps,
— glowing player corpses,
— glitch effects,
— and its own unique ending.[/p][p]Whether you reach the door… or die on level 5 —
[b]something will happen.[/b][/p][p]If you enjoy dark stories, psychological symbolism, and pixel art atmosphere — give it a try. And let me know what you think.[/p][p][b]I read every comment and piece of feedback.[/b]
Help me make this game stronger — the journey is just beginning.[/p]

notes.title: Welcome to My Nightmare — NEKRO3 Demo Coming Soon
notes.notes:
[p]Hi there.[/p][p]I'm developing NEKRO3 solo.
It’s a deeply personal game — born from pain, fear, and a longing for hope.[/p][p]NEKRO3 is a horror adventure where you die… and leave yourself behind.
Your glowing corpses light the way — or rise against you.
Each level is not just gameplay, but a piece of my inner hell.[/p][p]The demo — the first 5 levels — is coming very soon.[/p][p]If you enjoy dark indie games, a haunting sense of solitude, and experimental mechanics, add NEKRO3 to your wishlist and stay tuned.[/p][p][b]Thank you for being here.[/b][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45658287/309c8a5a2c1a43045396a34fd41950c01f9baa2b.jpg"][/img][/p]
